extracted.intended_audience: researchers and prospective applicants to the Kidney Cancer Research Program (KCRP); stakeholders including Service members, Veterans, clinicians, and kidney-cancer investigators
extracted.subtask_description: Program-level guidance describing the KCRP's vision, mission, strategic goals, and priority focus areas to guide research proposals seeking CDMRP KCRP funding. Use to align applications to program priorities and populations of interest (Service members, Veterans, public).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision
rubrics_metrics.description: Vision – To eliminate kidney cancer through collaboration and discovery
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should contribute toward the long-term program goal of eliminating kidney cancer, emphasizing collaborative and discovery-driven research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Mission – To promote rigorous, innovative, high impact research in kidney cancer for the benefit of Service members, Veterans, and the American public
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research supported should be rigorous, innovative, and have potential for high impact; proposals should explicitly state how outcomes will benefit Service members, Veterans, and/or the American public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Goal: Increase understanding of the biology of kidney cancer
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase understanding of the biology of kidney cancer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded projects should advance fundamental or translational biological knowledge of kidney cancer that could inform prevention, detection, or treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Goal: Develop novel therapeutic strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop novel therapeutic strategies for the treatment of kidney cancer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority for studies that propose new therapeutic concepts, modalities, drug targets, combination strategies, or technologies with potential to improve treatment outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Goal: Improve patient care
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve patient care for kidney cancer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should have clear relevance to improving diagnosis, clinical management, survivorship, or quality of care for kidney cancer patients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Goal: Grow the field and increase collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Grow the field and increase collaboration in the area of kidney cancer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that build collaborative networks, interdisciplinary research, or otherwise expand the community of investigators in kidney cancer are favored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program focus: prevention, detection, treatment, and long-term effects
rubrics_metrics.description: KCRP has continued its focus on issues regarding prevention, detection, treatment, including the long-term effects of kidney cancer treatment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications addressing prevention strategies, improved detection/diagnosis, therapeutic interventions, and long-term treatment effects (e.g., survivorship, late effects) align with program priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity building and next-generation investigator support
rubrics_metrics.description: building capacity with next-generation investigators and resources for novel kidney cancer treatments for Service Members, Veterans, their families, and the American public
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding priorities include training, career-development, and resource-building activities that develop the next generation of kidney cancer researchers and necessary infrastructure/resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to Service members, Veterans, and military populations
rubrics_metrics.description: For the benefit of Service members, Veterans, and the American public
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should, where possible, address issues particularly relevant to military and veteran populations (e.g., exposures, higher smoking prevalence) or explain how findings will benefit these groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to military-associated risk factors and exposures
rubrics_metrics.description: Active-duty Service Members are at increased risk of exposure to chlorinated solvents, petrochemicals, and heavy metals, all of which have been associated with increased risk of RCC
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Studies investigating etiology, exposure-related mechanisms, prevention, detection, or treatment related to military-relevant environmental/occupational exposures are especially pertinent to KCRP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for high-risk, high-impact approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: High Risk, High Impact: Investing in New Approaches
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KCRP supports novel, potentially high-payoff research. Applicants should highlight transformational potential and justify risk relative to potential impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with the KCRP Strategic Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: The KCRP has developed a strategic plan that articulates the most critical needs in kidney cancer and the research it seeks to promote.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should align objectives, aims, and proposed activities with priorities and needs described in the KCRP Strategic Plan and program summary materials.
